suppress.notes: CVE-2026-47838 affects SubjectDnX509PrincipalExtractor handling of malformed X.509 certificate CN values. Recetas Familiares authenticates with JWT and does not configure Spring Security X.509/client-certificate authentication or use SubjectDnX509PrincipalExtractor. As of 2026-07-11, Maven Central has no Spring Security 6.5.x release newer than 6.5.11; the available fixed line would require a Spring Security 7.x / Spring Boot major upgrade. Revisit when a compatible 6.5.x/Boot 3.5 fix exists.
